description: The shell points its window at core's own origin (http://127.0.0.1:8765), which Tauri classifies as remote, so the `default` capability above — which is local-only — does not reach the page. Without this the title bar cannot move the window: `data-tauri-drag-region` invokes `plugin:window|start_dragging`, and the ACL rejects every plugin command coming from a remote origin. Grant is deliberately two commands wide, not `core:default`: dragging the frame and the macOS double-click-to-zoom that pairs with it. Keep the URL in step with `CORE_PORT` in src/lib.rs.
